name: Microsoft Teams
description: Channel posts, chats and channels in Microsoft Teams.

objects.label: channel messages
objects.description: Posts and replies in one team channel. Teams only lists messages one channel at a time.

fields.label: reply
fields.description: A reply in a thread rather than a top-level post.

objects.label: chat messages
objects.description: Messages in one-to-one and group chats the account is part of. Not channel posts.

fields.label: chat
fields.description: The chat's name, or the people in it when it has no name.

objects.label: channels
objects.description: The channels in the teams the account belongs to.

actions.label: a message
actions.description: Post to a channel. Choose whether each item becomes its own post.

params.label: in the channel
params.description: Team and channel, like Marketing › General.

actions.label: a chat message
actions.description: Send a direct chat to a person or a group.

params.label: to
params.description: A person, several people, or a piece that holds people.

actions.label: a reply on each message
actions.description: Reply in the thread of each message in the source. The source must be Teams channel messages.

guidance: Teams is reached through the Microsoft Graph API. Reading channel and chat history needs application permissions that Microsoft only grants after a protected-API request, so most automations post through a Workflows webhook or a bot registered in Entra ID and read very little. Post to a channel people already watch rather than direct-messaging them, and never @mention a whole channel from an automation.

setup.notes: Ask the team owner to add a Workflows webhook to the channel if the plan only posts. If it reads messages, ask the Microsoft 365 administrator for an Entra ID app with Teams permissions; that approval can take a while.
